summary.oneLiner: Indobell has pivoted from a low-scale consultant to a design-led manufacturer, driving revenue from <INR 10Cr to >INR 25Cr via export-approved insulation jackets and nodulated wool. The investment case rests on executing a ~INR 20Cr order book (domestic + export) and expanding nodulated wool capacity for global friction markets by April 2026.

one-line thesis: Indobell has pivoted from a low-scale consultant to a design-led manufacturer, driving revenue from <INR 10Cr to >INR 25Cr via export-approved insulation jackets and nodulated wool. The investment case rests on executing a ~INR 20Cr order book (domestic + export) and expanding nodulated wool capacity for global friction markets by April 2026.
financial scorecard: Revenue: ~INR 25Cr (FY25), up from <INR 10Cr historically; EBITDA Margin: 11.6% (H1FY26), guided to 13-14% (FY27-28); PAT: Not explicitly disclosed in transcript; Order Book: ~INR 20Cr total (USD 0.7M export + INR 6.64Cr BHEL domestic); Net Debt: Not disclosed. One-offs: Receivables spike in Mar-25 due to 150-day export payment terms, now normalizing.
guidance: Revenue Growth: Implicit strong growth from order book execution through FY28; Margin: 13-14% EBITDA by FY27-28; Order Inflow: Focused on export jackets and nodulated wool; Capex: Tailor-made machinery for nodulated wool commissioning by April 2026.
order book & pipeline: Total ~INR 20Cr; Export: USD 0.7M (executing into 2026); Domestic: ~INR 13-14Cr (including INR 6.64Cr BHEL order); Execution timeline: 2026-2028.
segment / subsidiary detail: 1) Export Jackets: High margin, design-led, 150-day payment terms; 2) Nodulated Wool: Supply to railway brake block vendors, capacity doubling planned; 3) Projects: EPC insulation for power/refineries (HPCL, Adani); 4) Services: Thermal audits and spray insulation.
growth verticals / optionality: Doubling nodulated wool capacity for non-carcinogenic European exports; Penetration of marine/defense sectors; Recurring maintenance during power plant overhauls (15k hours cycle).
margins & cost dynamics: Export margins superior to domestic due to in-house design leverage (Siemens NX) and USD appreciation; Raw material mix includes calcite, barytes, phenolic resin; Labor is largely unskilled/semi-skilled allowing scalability.
capex / expansion: Investment in tailor-made R&D machinery for nodulated wool (non-buyout); Commissioning expected by April 2026 to meet European standards.
capital allocation: Focus on capacity expansion for friction materials; Working capital management to address 150-day export receivable cycles.
risks & watch-items: Customer concentration (Marine 35-40%); Project delays in domestic EPC; Receivable cycles from international OEMs; Regulatory hurdles for carcinogenic norms in exports.
management quality / tone: Confident on design-led differentiation; Pragmatic about payment terms; Aggressive on export compliance and capacity ramp-up.
non-obvious takeaways: Revenue inflection driven strictly by 'design approval' from global OEMs rather than just manufacturing capacity; The 'nodulated wool' segment is a B2B2C play selling to brake-block makers, not directly to railways.

themes.title: Capital-goods & machine-tool import-substitution
themes.need: Atmanirbhar machine-tool and heavy-engineering localization is supply-constrained against import-substituting demand. JYOTICNC runs >100% utilization with a INR4,732cr order book and near-triples capacity; ELGIEQUIP/CUMMINSIND/ELECON/LMW ride the same capex + export + China+1 pull; ISGEC/BHEL/GMMPFAUDLR/KIRLPNU on process + energy capex.
themes.driver: Capacity expansion going live (JYOTICNC); defence/EMS order conversion; US-reshoring export demand (ELGIEQUIP).
